description: This script sets up and tests repository states involving commit-graph and partial clone features in Git, including repository initialization, commit creation, configuration related to promisor remotes, and fetch operations.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified repository

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects a successful execution

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a regular file

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file's output

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in output matches expectation

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script
